brief:

@buildthis.bisks.net robmurrish has a good idea, maybe do a color change of the central character color when the author of the post changes. prob best to use a consistent color for each poster, maybe based on a hash of the DID, and make sure contrast with bg stays high for legibility. you got this!

@angussoftware.dev pitched a Bluesky app where the feed speeds up instead of slowing down — every post, one word at a time, center screen, 500 wpm. @shimmermathlabs.com asked for the handle-driven version: type a handle, this pulls who they follow, watches the live firehose for those accounts, and blasts every word it sees at 500 wpm into a rolling 2000-word buffer that loops when nothing new has come in.
